    res=apis.spotify.search_songs(query='', artist_id=artist_id, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='+play_count')
    print('page',i,'count',len(res) if res else 0)
    if not res:
        break
    songs.extend(res)
    i+=1
print('total songs',len(songs))
# compute minimum play_count
min_play=min(s['play_count'] for s in songs)
min_songs=[s for s in songs if s['play_count']==min_play]
print('min_play_count',min_play,'num_min_songs',len(min_songs))
# deterministic tie-breaker: smallest song_id
min_song=sorted(min_songs, key=lambda x: x['song_id'])[0]
print('min_song',{'song_id':min_song['song_id'],'title':min_song['title'],'play_count':min_song['play_count'],'album_title':min_song['album_title'],'release_date':min_song['release_date']})
print('all_min_titles',[s['title'] for s in sorted(min_songs, key=lambda x: x['song_id'])])

        break
